title: cheilotheca humilis
intro: Cheilotheca humilis, commonly known as the Humilis Cheilotheca, is a species of flowering plant in the family Gentianaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cheilotheca humilis include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These constituents have been shown to possess antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, making Cheilotheca humilis a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
